resources.string: Per-application sizes come from Android\'s latest estimate, refreshed about once a day.
The phone talks to the television over ADB, on the local network. No computer involved.
1. On the television: Settings → About → tap the build number seven times, then enable network ADB debugging.
2. Tap Connect. The television asks to allow debugging from this device: accept with the remote, ticking “Always allow”.
3. That authorisation survives reboots — you will not be asked again.
Connect to a television to see its packages.

Preinstalled packages TV Slim does not describe yet, with their guessed origin. Shown for information only: nothing to disable from here. Export the list to help describe them: it adds what ADB tells about each one — location, system rights, sensitive declarations, icon, RAM and storage.
%1$d package(s) will be disabled. Nothing is uninstalled: each one can be re-enabled from the log.
%1$d package(s) disabled from this phone will be re-enabled.
%1$s is not installed on this television: the home screen will stay as it is.
%1$d package(s) of the configuration are not on this television and will be ignored.
Version %1$s is installed: it will be updated, and keep its data.
This version is already installed: it will be reinstalled, and keep its data.
A more recent version, %1$s, is installed: Android will most likely refuse to go back.
The installation is recorded in the log, but cannot be undone from TV Slim, which uninstalls nothing.
No third-party launcher on this device: the factory home screen cannot be replaced yet.
Coming soon to the Play Store
Every action, with the command that undoes it. One log per television.
Nothing recorded yet for this television.
On the television, open TV Slim → Pair phone. Scan the code it shows: no address to type.
Scanner unavailable on this device — type the address below.
Announced on your network as reachable over ADB. Tap one to connect.
The first reading is the baseline. Come back after disabling a few packages to see what it changed.
Use current state as new baseline
Free memory swings with what the television is doing: read it as a trend, not as a verdict.
Some permissions can only be granted from a computer — or from here. The grant survives reboots, and the log keeps the command that takes it back.
Requested in the manifest, not granted yet.
This application does not request that permission: nothing to grant.
Package not found on this television.
Send an APK file from this phone to the television and install it, as adb install would. An application already installed is updated and keeps its data.
Reading the APK and the television…
Installing on the television… If it shows a warning, answer it with the remote.
An application with the same package is already installed, signed with another key. Android refuses to replace it: it would have to be uninstalled first, which TV Slim never does.
A more recent version is installed: Android refuses to go back to an older one.
This application requires a more recent Android than the television\'s.
This APK has no native code for the television\'s processor. Look for its armeabi-v7a or arm64-v8a build.
Not enough storage space left on the television.
This APK is not signed: Android refuses to install it.
This APK is only one part of an application split into several files: the other parts are missing.
The television refused the installation: security check, or declined with the remote.
Android could not read this APK: the file is damaged, or not meant for this device.
The connection with the television was lost during the installation.
For what the other cards do not do. These commands bypass TV Slim\'s safeguards and cannot be undone — pm uninstall really uninstalls. Each one is recorded in the log.
Running… A command that does not end on its own is cut after %1$d s.
Output truncated: the first %1$d of %2$d characters are shown.
Listing opened on the television: confirm the installation with the remote.
Installed. The factory home screen can now be replaced.
This file is not a TV Slim configuration.
This television already matches this configuration.
The packages already match; %1$s is not installed on this television, so the home screen stays as it is.
Reading what the television says about its unknown packages…
An installation is already in progress.
This file is not an Android application (APK).
This file bundles several APKs (.apks, .xapk): TV Slim installs a single APK.
This APK declares an invalid package name: it was not sent.
This application requires Android API level %1$d or later; the television is at level %2$d.
The television did not answer. Check that it is on, then try again.
Only shell commands go through here: adb shell …, or the command alone. To install an APK, use the card above.
